shortDescription: Deploy software (or files) from bzr branches

options.name: dest
options.description: Absolute path of where the branch should be cloned to.

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to C(bzr) executable to use. If not supplied, the normal mechanism for resolving binary paths is used.

options.name: force
options.description: If V(true), any modified files in the working tree is discarded.

options.name: name
options.description: SSH or HTTP protocol address of the parent branch.

options.name: version
options.description: What version of the branch to clone. This can be the bzr revno or revid.
